# N4: Review notes, shell-settings: Settings with theme, accent and sidebar; Goals as a nav section; no switcher for one workspace; Back on detail pages; workspace and team admin; Faro’s name, logo and colours

A check of the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/notes/4-shell-settings.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured, and a limit its words don’t give is added after it, in the script’s test (“its test: …”).

## What it checks

Lane's review notes (5 Nov), shell-settings. Settings (light, dark or system; an accent colour; a full or icons-only sidebar; your AI assistants), Goals as a section of the navigation, no workspace switcher for someone in one workspace, a Back link on detail pages, and an admin renaming the workspace and adding, renaming and removing teams. Measured in the built app at phone, tablet and desktop widths.

## Where it looks

- 1280 × 800, as rhea, at `/`
- 390 × 844, as rhea, at `/`, on a touch screen
- 1280 × 800, as rhea, at `/settings`
- 1440 × 900, as rhea, at `/`

- 768 × 1024, as amara, at `/workspace`, on a touch screen
- 390 × 844, as amara, at `/workspace`, on a touch screen
- 1280 × 800, as rhea, at `/teams`

A width of 390 is a phone, 1440 (or 1280) a desktop; the address is in the demo on Thursday 5 November 2026 unless it names another day. {…} is a value the script works out as it runs.
